title: QUARTILE functions coerce quart first, reject negative fractions before truncation, and return #NAME? in compat-1
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, QUARTILE, QUARTILE.INC, and QUARTILE.EXC coerce the quart selector before inspecting array/range errors (so non-numeric quart yields #VALUE! even over #N/A cells), but validate the selector domain after reading sample errors and reject negative fractions such as -0.5 or -MIN_POSITIVE with #NUM! before truncating quart (so 4.5 truncates to 4 while -0.5 fails). Under compatibility version 1, @QUARTILE.INC and @QUARTILE.EXC return #NAME?.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (rows 187-189) and quartile_selector_admission_and_error_order controls, and matched across 2,856/2,856 QUARTILE, 2,854/2,854 QUARTILE.EXC, and 2,851/2,851 QUARTILE.INC full-bank rows.
